definition.prompt: Draw a project-original adult fantasy swordsman as one full-body character reference, not an existing anime character. Short dark teal hair tied in a small ponytail, amber eyes, navy tunic and trousers, pale aqua wave-patterned sleeveless haori, brown sash and sandals, and one sheathed curved sword with a turquoise guard held at the waist. Calm determined expression, front three-quarter standing pose, both hands and feet visible. Crisp anime line art and flat colors, pure white background, generous margins. No text, no logo, no sprite grid. The later animation will convert this original character to pixel art and a water-themed strike.
